agent.result_text:
This change was already in the app, so I didn't edit anything. I ran `bin/e2e` on the code as it stands and all 4 tests in `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts` pass.

The existing code already handles every part of the request:

- **Screen:** each pending claim has a reason box (`claim-reject-reason`) next to its Reject button (`claim-reject`). If the reason is blank or only spaces, nothing is sent and the claim shows "Enter a reason to reject this claim." in `claim-error` (`claims.ts:1050`).
- **Server:** the reject request rejects a blank reason (`ClaimController.java:291`). `ClaimService.reject` trims the reason and refuses an empty one with a 422 before changing anything, so a refused reject writes nothing to the store or the audit file (`ClaimService.java:926`).
- **Audit:** a successful reject appends ` reason=<reason>` at the end of the `CLAIM_REJECTED` line, which is the form the test expects (e.g. `... date=2026-03-10 reason=no`).
